_about: Independent, known-conformant UCP servers the differential gate (differential.py) runs the suite against, to catch checks that pass our own fixture but false-flag a server we did NOT author (the fixture-circularity risk). URLs are resolved from an environment variable (server_env) so real endpoints/secrets are never committed. The gate SKIPs cleanly when none are reachable, and also accepts an ad-hoc --server on the command line. Add your own conformant staging server here to keep the suite honest against a second implementation.

targets.name: flower-shop-official-sample
targets.note: The official UCP Flower Shop sample server — an implementation independent of our controlled fixture. Served locally by conformance/ci/serve_golden.sh. As of the 2026-07-31 re-pin it serves spec version 2026-04-08 (it served 2026-01-23 under the previous pin), so this target now exercises the 04-08 lane. Set UCP_FLOWER_SHOP_URL to its base URL to include it.

targets.name: nodejs-reference-sample
targets.note: The official UCP Node.js reference server (samples/rest/nodejs — a Hono + Zod + @ucp-js/sdk app), a SECOND independent implementation whose author is not us AND not the Python golden. It advertises spec 2026-04-08 (src/utils/config.ts UCP_VERSION), so it exercises the 04-08 lane against a genuinely separate codebase, catching any check that quietly encoded Python-flower-specific behavior. The old '01-23-era incompatible' ops note is STALE: at samples HEAD a95b928b this sample targets 04-08 and 40 merchant checks clean-pass against it. Served locally by conformance/ci/serve_node_reference.sh (seeds the same flower catalog into its SQLite, boots via tsx on :3000). Two genuine Node-reference deviations are silenced in differential_allowlist.json (DISC-003 Cache-Control, PAY-003 ucp.payment_handlers echo) — both are real Node bugs anchored to the official 04-08 spec/schema, not check bugs. Set UCP_NODEJS_URL to its base URL to include it. NOTE the sample's own `npm run build && npm start` is broken (extensionless ESM imports — upstream samples#58, still reproducing); run it with tsx as the serve script does.
